title: Specify expression error tests
description: You can read two supplied tests as requirements for parser diagnostics.

steps.description: test_bad_operator passes a malformed expression to parse_error and keeps the returned error.
The assertions require an expression diagnostic naming STAR and the source position (1, 13).

steps.question: Does the second test check a source position as well as a message?
steps.answer: It checks only that the required message text appears.

steps.description: test_mismatched_paren requires a message naming RPAREN and SEMICOLON. This snippet defines the tests; the supplied trace records definitions rather than test execution.
